scientific_integrity.proven_scope: all inner I and all nonzero outer F in Hardy H^(1/2)

scientific_limitations: Sharpness is proved for the phase-optimized de Leeuw–Rudin decomposition envelope, not for the best bounded-functional estimate.
The theorem is specific to the Hardy exponent one half; it does not classify other exponents.
A complete independent historical literature audit, including possible implicit reverse-Hölder coverage, has not been performed.
title: A sharp two-moment nonextremality bound in Hardy \(H^{1/2}\)
